app.name: AgentWatch
evidence.tip.E3: Reported by the agent itself, not confirmed at the system layer
evidence.tip.S: Sampled; short-lived events may be missing
evidence.tip.I: Inferred by a correlation rule; not a fact
evidence.tip.NA: This field cannot be obtained on the current platform or mode
na.es_no_read_event: macOS provides no per-read events; only the open-for-read is known
na.mmap_not_observable: File was accessed through a memory mapping; byte counts are unavailable
na.tls_no_proxy: TLS without a proxy; URL unavailable
na.direct_bypass_proxy: Process connected directly, bypassing the proxy; URL unavailable
na.cert_pinned: Client rejected the proxy certificate (certificate pinning suspected)
na.quic: QUIC/HTTP3 does not pass through the HTTP proxy; URL unavailable
na.ech: Encrypted ClientHello in use; domain unavailable
na.no_dns_observed: No DNS resolution was observed (DoH or a hardcoded IP possible)
na.preexisting: Already existed before attach; earlier data unavailable
na.collector_unavailable: The current mode cannot collect this (see aw doctor)
na.attribution_break: Performed by a process outside the session; attribution chain broken
na.partial_client_hello: TLS handshake first packet incomplete; domain unavailable
na.h2_hpack: HTTP/2 headers are compressed; full URL unavailable
na.too_large: File or body exceeds the comparison limit
na.file_changed: File changed before comparison; result unusable
na.peer_unknown: The process at the other end of the channel could not be determined
na.protocol_not_observed: mcp-tap or proxy not enabled; method and tool name unavailable
auth.title: Sign-in required
auth.body: Open this page with aw ui. The ticket is single use; refreshing requires signing in again.
density.aria: Time density bar; drag to select a range
density.gap: A collection gap falls in this span
detail.title: Record detail
detail.empty: Select a record to see its fields and evidence
bytes.approx: Partly sampled or covering a gap window: {reason}
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.col.name: Name / command
sessions.deleteConfirm: Delete session “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
sessions.compareDisabled: Comparison comes in a later phase
new.title: New session
new.proxyTip: Launch injects HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY, plus NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, SSL_CERT_FILE, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE and GIT_SSL_CAINFO. Older Node.js built-in fetch, Go using the system trust store, and Electron / Chromium may ignore these.
new.noTty: Programs launched from the UI have no interactive terminal; use aw run for interactive agents.
overview.findingsEmpty: No activity matching the rules was found within what was observed
overview.findingsLater: Finding rules arrive in a later phase; this is a placeholder.
timeline.findingLater: Inference and finding evidence are shown in a later phase
procs.snapshot: From a snapshot; time precision is limited by the sampling interval
procs.breakTip: Attribution break: later activity happened outside this session and is not counted
net.basis: Byte basis: bytes_up / bytes_down are transport-layer payload bytes. They include TLS record overhead, HTTP headers and protocol frames, and exclude IP/TCP/UDP headers, retransmits and ACKs. HTTP body bytes exclude headers.
net.httpPlaceholder: Proxy was not enabled for this session
net.httpLater: HTTP request detail arrives in a later phase
net.noPtr: Only domain mappings observed inside the session are shown; no reverse lookup is done
gaps.jump: Show this span in the timeline
settings.title: Settings
settings.purgeConfirm: Clean up finished sessions under the current retention policy? Pinned sessions are kept.
settings.proxyReadonly: Proxy settings become editable in a later phase
settings.rulesReadonly: Rule toggles become editable in a later phase
settings.forbidden: This identity cannot change this setting
search.title: Search across sessions
search.placeholder: Free text or a filter, e.g. ~/.aws/credentials
search.slow: Substring search is slow: full-text index is off
findings.group.contentInfo: Request body chunk-matched a file read in this session — the strongest correlation evidence. No match does not mean no upload.
findings.group.factInfo: Directly observed by the kernel or confirmed via the protocol layer (E2).
findings.group.inferredInfo: Derived by a correlation rule, not directly observed. A caveat is always shown.
findings.inferredCaveat: Temporal proximity does not mean file content was sent.
findings.contentMatchCaveat: Encrypted, re-encoded, or hashed content cannot be matched; no match does not mean no transmission.
findings.gapCaveat: A collection gap exists during this window (gap ID: {id}); findings may be incomplete.
findings.empty: No rule-matching activity found within the observed scope
selfReport.title: Self-report
selfReport.lead: Left: what the agent reported (E3). Right: what the system observed (E1 / E2). The two lists are not paired.
selfReport.noE3: No E3 self-report rows in this session.
selfReport.noObserved: No E1 or E2 rows in the loaded window.
selfReport.agentEventsNa: unavailable — daemon has no agent-events list; rows shown are timeline items only.
selfReport.httpNa: unavailable — daemon has no HTTP route for this session.
selfReport.unmatchedNa: unavailable — daemon has no compare API yet, so nothing is marked matched or unmatched.
compare.title: Compare sessions
compare.lead: Session identity is loaded from the daemon. A difference set is not: the daemon has no compare API yet.
compare.same: The two sides are the same session.
compare.capabilityNote: Collector capabilities differ. A difference, once one can be listed, may come from what each side could observe.
compare.apiNa: unavailable — daemon has no compare API yet.
compare.noVerdict: This view does not rank the two sessions.
